name: Alshar
source:
A female pirate who makes the vast Beryl Sea her home. She is a brown-skinned beauty with huge breasts. She is also quite skilled with a sword. 

She is bold and daring. When Leen becomes the count of Galicia, she comes all the way to the reception hall to see him even though she knows she is being targeted. 

She is an excellent leader and her crew follows her loyally. She is also a good cook, and her crew sometimes beg her to cook for them.

[From [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/103kyonyu5/#character]official site[/url]]
